extraction_notes: Main-text measured catalytic-performance plots are Figure 1a (CO2 conversion bars and methanol selectivity lines vs temperature), Figure 1b (methanol formation rate vs Ir loading at 300 °C), and Figure 6d (STY vs relative oxygen vacancy for Ir/In2O3-1/5/10 at 300 °C). Figure 6d duplicates the 300 °C STY points from Figure 1b and was merged into those records. Characterization plots, DFT/model energy plots, and TEM/XRD/XPS/TPR/TPD/Raman figures were otherwise skipped. CO is stated to be the only measurable byproduct, with trace methane above 275 °C too small to quantify, but CO and CH4 selectivities were not plotted in the main-text performance figures.
